clusters.summary_zh: 上海承担总部、芯片、软件、国际合作和整车制造；常州具有电池与新能源整车；苏州和宁波拥有汽车电子与零部件；合肥和芜湖承担快速增长的整车生产。完整链还应包含杭州，将在二期补入。
clusters.summary_en: Shanghai carries HQ, chips, software, international cooperation and vehicle plants; Changzhou batteries and NEVs; Suzhou and Ningbo electronics and parts; Hefei and Wuhu fast-growing vehicle output. Hangzhou joins in phase 2.
clusters.output_note_zh: 国家发展改革委区域资料将上海软件芯片、常州动力电池和宁波整车制造作为协作案例。
clusters.output_note_en: NDRC regional materials cite Shanghai software/chips, Changzhou batteries and Ningbo vehicle manufacturing as a collaboration case.

clusters.name_zh: 粤港澳大湾区汽车网络
clusters.summary_zh: 广州多品牌整车；深圳比亚迪总部、汽车电子和智能驾驶；惠州德赛西威、华阳和亿纬锂能。佛山、东莞将在二期补入。
clusters.summary_en: Guangzhou multi-brand plants; Shenzhen BYD HQ, electronics and autonomy; Huizhou Desay SV, HuaYang and EVE. Foshan and Dongguan join in phase 2.
clusters.output_note_zh: 广州和深圳官方产业规划均将跨城市协作列为重要方向。
clusters.output_note_en: Guangzhou and Shenzhen official industry plans both treat cross-city collaboration as a priority.

clusters.summary_zh: 北京总部、算法、软件和创新平台；天津整车、检测标准和港口；保定长城总部和制造。廊坊等河北配套城市二期补入。
clusters.summary_en: Beijing HQ, algorithms, software and platforms; Tianjin vehicles, testing standards and port; Baoding GWM HQ and manufacturing. Langfang joins in phase 2.
clusters.output_note_zh: 京津冀已形成以数小时运输半径组织的汽车供应链。
clusters.output_note_en: Jing-Jin-Ji already organises auto supply on a same-day trucking radius.

clusters.summary_zh: 重庆与成都构成整车和零部件双中心，宜宾提供动力电池产业支持。
clusters.summary_en: Chongqing and Chengdu form a dual vehicle-and-parts centre; Yibin supplies power batteries.
clusters.output_note_zh: 2024年成渝地区汽车产量约343万辆，新能源汽车约108.7万辆。
clusters.output_note_en: In 2024 the Chengdu–Chongqing region produced about 3.43 million vehicles, including about 1.087 million NEVs.

clusters.summary_zh: 武汉侧重乘用车、新能源和智能网联；十堰侧重中重型商用车。襄阳、随州二期补入，适合做成东风历史专题。
clusters.summary_en: Wuhan: passenger cars, NEVs and intelligent connectivity; Shiyan: medium/heavy commercial vehicles. Xiangyang and Suizhou join in phase 2 as a Dongfeng history special.

clusters.summary_zh: 长沙拥有比亚迪、广汽埃安和上汽大众。株洲新能源商用车和湘潭吉利体系二期补入。
clusters.summary_en: Changsha hosts BYD, GAC Aion and SAIC Volkswagen. Zhuzhou NEV commercial vehicles and Xiangtan's Geely system join in phase 2.

clusters.summary_zh: 长春作为一汽总部与历史核心独立呈现，后续连接沈阳华晨宝马供应网络。
clusters.summary_en: Changchun is presented as FAW HQ and historical core; Shenyang BMW Brilliance supply joins later.

clusters.summary_zh: 郑州同时承担比亚迪综合制造和宇通全球客车影响力。
clusters.summary_en: Zhengzhou hosts both BYD integrated manufacturing and Yutong's global coach role.

clusters.summary_zh: 柳州以五菱、柳汽和本地汽车文化构成相对完整的地方车城。
clusters.summary_en: Liuzhou forms a relatively complete local auto city around Wuling, Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor and civic auto culture.

clusters.summary_zh: 宁德总部、常州集聚、宜宾能源条件、合肥国轩与整车、惠州亿纬，用来说明电池城市不必拥有整车厂。
clusters.summary_en: CATL HQ, Changzhou agglomeration, Yibin energy conditions, Hefei Gotion plus vehicles, Huizhou EVE — battery cities need not host OEM plants.

clusters.summary_zh: 西安以比亚迪大规模制造进入全国产量第一梯队。
clusters.summary_en: Xi'an entered the national output first tier through BYD-scale manufacturing.

clusters.summary_zh: 济南以重汽商用车叠加比亚迪、吉利新能源整车。青岛一汽-大众/解放/奇瑞将在二期补入。
clusters.summary_en: Jinan stacks Sinotruk commercial vehicles with BYD and Geely NEV plants. Qingdao FAW-VW/Jiefang/Chery joins in phase 2.

clusters.summary_zh: 厦门金龙与金旅代表客车和新能源商用车出口路径。
clusters.summary_en: Xiamen King Long and Golden Dragon represent the coach and NEV-commercial export path.
